doc: Which Agent-tool model overrides scripts/hooks/guard-agent-model.sh denies unless the dispatch prompt carries an `ESCALATION: <reason>` line. Documented in docs/internals/enforcement.md.
why: HIMMEL-3630 made Opus 5.5 high the judge default: about $8.23 vs $21.94 per verdict (HIMMEL-3595) with no missed finding. An in-process Agent call passing `model: fable` silently overrides console-judge's `model: opus` frontmatter, so the policy is structural rather than prose.

Today there is no standing case for Fable. A newer Fable model is expected: this file is the ONE place the block lives, so unblocking or re-targeting a model is a one-line reviewed change here, not a hook rewrite.

semantics.blocked_model_patterns: case-insensitive (input is lowercased) regexes, tested against the Agent call's `model`. A match is denied unless the prompt has an acceptable ESCALATION line. Remove an entry to unblock that model; an empty list blocks nothing.
semantics.min_reason_chars: an ESCALATION reason shorter than this (after trimming) is treated as no reason.
semantics.placeholder_reasons: reasons rejected outright. The reason is lowercased, every run of non-alphanumerics becomes one space, then compared, so `N/A.` matches `n a`.
semantics.not_covered: a console-judge dispatch whose model is not opus stays denied by the hook itself (its frontmatter tier, not a model name); the same ESCALATION rule applies.
